answer: Require every agent to post a refundable bond that is slashed for proven fake identities, so creating thousands of clones stops being cheap. Think of the bond as a harbor fee: each inlet to the marketplace must present a distinct, verifiable signal of prior useful work, such as a signed history of completed tasks. An attacker can still mint new identities, but each one must pay the fee and build that history again, so Sybil scale collapses under its own cost while honest agents keep their bond.
